knowHow.text: Thanks to the material's excellent printability and static dissipation properties, ESD-ABS is suitable for general manufacturing and electronic industries.

Thanks to this advanced production process, the residual amounts of solvents and monomers used in the production process in the final ABS product are extremely low, so the consumables are printed The process has low odor.
It is an ideal filament for applications in automotive, aerospace, semiconductor industry, electronic and electrical industries.
ESD ABS, like ABS, has good heat resistance, high tenacity and impact resistance, and good antistatic performance as well.
Recommended Support Material Self-supporting, HIPS
As the ESD ABS filament absorbs moisture easily, it should be dried before being used.
it is suitable for areas that req uire electrostatic protection for precision electronic components, integrated circuits and their packages.
ABS-ESD is an antistatic modified material with excellent permanent antistatic effect, surface resistivity of 109Ω, easy to print and smooth surface.
Low warpage
Smooth Print Surface
Its functional temperature of up to 100 °C makes it particularly suited for the protection of electronics that can heat up, such as mother boards.
Ideal for housing and protecting hard drives as well as creation of electronic connectors.
Nanovia ABS ESD, with its conductive carbon enriched matrix, discharges static electricity generated by friction or by electrical components.
To preserve the fillament’s ESD properties, pieces should not be covered using insulating paints.
Whilst printing ABS produces a VOC derivative of styrene.
It can dissipate electric charges due to it’s lower electrical resistivity.
Good mechanical strength, stiffness, and hardness Moderate impact resistance Good thermal stability
ABSx ESD offers excellent electrostatic energy dissipation and was specifically developed to protect sensitive electronic components from electrostatic discharge.
Easier to print than most industrial-grade materials
The filament is ideal for industrial applications like housings / casings for connectors, sensors and measuring devices.
Fiberlogy ABS ESD is a specialized filament designed to protect sensitive electronic components from electrostatic discharge (ESD).
Durable and sturdy parts off practically every machine on the market

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. INEOS Styrolution's sheet for Terluran GP-22 (R-INEOS-TERLURAN-GP22-TDS), a general-purpose ABS injection-moulding grade, prints a density of 1040 kg/m³ (ISO 1183) and a water absorption of 1 % saturated at 23 °C and 0.22 % at equilibrium at 23 °C / 50 % RH (ISO 62), p. 2. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives ABS 1.01-1.21 Mg/m³.
